statement: Luminous Menagerie is a major new patch feature and requires having progressed into World 7 to unlock
Menagerie has an ever-growing list of 25 missions that rank up the Menagerie and unlock more missions and bonuses and content
25 unique bonuses to buy that add gameplay mechanics to explore rather than being mere stat bonuses
Menagerie unlocks a new sailing artifact tier and a new sailing boat type
Menagerie unlocks a new Coral Kid divinity upgrade
Menagerie unlocks a way to streamline Spelunking page readings
Menagerie unlocks include cooking ladle use and a Spelunking shortcut system
25 upgradeable menagerie bonuses include research EXP gain multi and gaming pellets and exotic market doublers and forge speed multi
Read the whole patch notes before ranking up Menagerie since older content additions boost the Menagerie
New monster Magni Pufferfish found at the Molten Edge which is currently the last World 7 map
New card from Magni Pufferfish gives a passive boost to Lumi gains
New coral reef fish to rescue are found in the new map 15 away from World 7 town
New Omega arcade upgrades give additional 3x that stacks with Super 2x and cost two Omega balls each earned from Menagerie
Five new coin types each worth 100 of the previous coin
Needs about 10 billion of previous best coin to get one of the new best coin
Enigma Fragment sailing artifact is now the Blood Clock and gives a new jelly operator bonus
One new alchemy liquid shop purchase added and it is very expensive due to inflation
One new Zenith Market upgrade added
New dancing coral bought with gilded coral dropped by Magni Puffin gives lumi gains based on crescent shrine level
One new Jade Emporium purchase added
One new Zooperbit upgrade to buy in gaming
Two new research grid upgrades E4 and F4 added
Baby menagerie from F4 is permanently unlocked by default but only for those who played during release
Top 0.01% name tag is earned by maxing menagerie unlocks and depositing 12 0.1% name tags to gallery; cosmetic only
New gem shop bundles added but Omega balls and new doublers are not bundle exclusive and can be earned playing Menagerie
Eidolon doggy plushy purchase supports a charity for service animals per the streamer
Player stats now show crystal mob guarantee and chance instead of giant mob chance
Arcade shop now shows whether a bonus is multiplicative
You can now hold down to upgrade super quickly in Wind Walker's Compass
Hold-down buying added for black pearls and divinity pearls and holy pearls and several shops including Glimbo swap meet and sushi shakers and sigil syrup
Hold-down buying in Glimbo swap meet risks accidentally buying too many of an unwanted item
OG multiplier display adjusted with million notations so large OGs do not overlap
Depositing a vanity ninja hat to the hat rack removes it from the monster's drop table
Permanent display of depth and manic depth added for each cavern when manic mode is unlocked
Mouse wheel scroll now works on the swap players UI and the in-game patch notes UI
Max chance for a free What's Under the Log game chance is set to 75%
Max crit chance displayed is now 200% while the real value remains for shimmer trial; display change only
Late World 3 related royal armory upgrades now cost wool instead giving more reason to collect it; neither buff nor nerf
No Meal Left Behind wool cap at 150 levels for all meals so high level meals again need cooking speed such as from menagerie
Sailing loot value buffed as captain loot bonus is now its own multiplier instead of additive
Fixed number display for Bubba's chromatic mega flash so you know how many you have
Fixed bug preventing use of more than 30 summoning doublers even if owned
Proper formatting added to resource multiplier display in AFK info for large numbers
Fixed bug where magic beans did not reset growth rate immediately which killed the metal tech
World 6 town crystal now correctly shows up in slab
Fixed strong coid in jelly operator lasting three seconds instead of the full five
Coral Kid first bonus now displayed as multiplier notation since it was a true multiplier shown as additive
Fixed display of royal guardian tip top source upgrade; the bonus always worked but display was inaccurate
Metal tech was fixed shortly after his video about it and had been in game around 2 years
Pit of Pages has not been fixed in this patch
He expects to have feelings about No Meal Left Behind at some point
Early on lumi gains are very low and this limits progress; fix it via research and other sources
Missions are on the left and you get more missions by clicking on the right-hand side
Research E4 node gives extra lumi gains and extra missions which is a big blocker; pay-to-win pack gives about five more
F4 is a pretty good direct multiplier to lumi gains
New zuper bit node in gaming gives 25% extra lumi gains
Focus on increasing lumi gains first since it shrinks time to reach the new mechanics
Early upgrades on the right are cheap and multiply lumi gains and mission access so get a couple first
Menagerie artifacts are cheap and you should buy them almost immediately
He has heard the artifacts are quite difficult to get
Spelunking shortcut system gives a shortcut every 50 depths which presumably skips floors
Skipping floors via shortcuts might miss chances for extra elixirs which are critical to every Spelunking setup
Singularity mode is toggled on at Coral Kid in divinity and unlocks a new mechanic with a Transmute button
Divinity points can be transmuted into singularity spirals; also time elapsed from claiming a divinity AFK and a divinity point multi
Bring new currency up to the inventory row under the OK button and spam click to fill an entire page
Hold shift at the cauldron and click them all out of inventory fast to multiply temps per day on a vial
Vial tech gets you vials; the new vial also increases lumi gains
Placed royal guardians on the new tunnel to farm the new spelunking scroll
He saved his reads from today to use on new content and has about 3 hours to farm scrolls before reset
